name: queue_event_effect_package_load

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_QueueEventEffectPackageLoad_Cmd165 consumes a path-prefix index and package ID, formats the paired event-effect package paths, queues the asynchronous load, and decrements Script stackTop by two

notes: ScriptCommand_QueueEventEffectPackageLoad_Cmd165 builds paired eveffect/<table-prefix>_%03d.dpp and .dpx paths, queues the DPP load into memory slot 0x32, records package_id, and sets asynchronous load bit 44. It is the memory-slot-0x32 counterpart of command 734, which performs the same load into slot 0x3C. The JP corpus contains two calls.

relations.difference: Command 165 loads the paired package into memory slot 0x32; command 734 uses slot 0x3C.
